utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 30th. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, you're on. Before we start, though—the football last night. What was that about?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Some of us are trying to forget it, mate.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fair enough. That's the football review finished, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Whose new car is that in the car park? The shiny one taking up most of the view.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I saw that coming in. Parked miles from everyone else. Clearly hasn't met our pigeons yet.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Give it a week. It'll look like the rest of ours.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto pigeon damage—finished bits first, then what's actually still open.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so, I already swapped the filter on the line 3 screw yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, that was the one I remembered being on the list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Was on it, yeah. Not another filter change for today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Forklift Fleet on Tuesday. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Both finished, not carry-overs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I tested the line 3 chiller yesterday and it's all fine now. Nothing further on that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good. Easy to lose the actual work under all the old entries, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: One observation, not a job: I noticed the relief valve was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Settled back down, did it? Not still running warm?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, settled down. Just passing on what I saw, no new action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. The permit to work and isolation for the guard switch on two—that still needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the guard switch on two by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. Agreed, by the end of the week, not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah. That's me sorting the permit and isolation, just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. Not recording that as you replacing the switch as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on the open bits, I'll grease and check the bearings on the main conveyor this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out a bit. Grease and check the bearings, both?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Both, yeah. I'll grease and check them this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got you, Fiona. Main conveyor, this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On my side, I can't get to the dryer until production gives us a window. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window available. That's where we are with it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, dryer stays blocked. We're not agreeing a start or handing out another job on that here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the palletiser, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, not part of today's agreed work. That one keeps cropping up in conversation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. I'll replace the seals on the PRV on the boiler after lunch. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just the seals on that one, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, the seals. I'll do that after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Okay, Saz on the seals for the PRV on the boiler. Normal priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on the 3rd? Whenever you get a chance on that date; it's not a rush one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, no, sorry. I can't do the 3rd. You'll have to give that one to someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right. Fiona, can you take that instead—do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on the 3rd? Whenever you get a chance on the day.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll do the site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on the 3rd, whenever I get a chance that day.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Separate from the main conveyor this morning, obviously. Two different entries for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, Fiona. Bearings this morning; site visit on the 3rd. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: You could borrow the shiny car for the visit. Arrive looking terribly important.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Only if you're allowed within ten feet of it. I reckon there's an exclusion zone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Behave. Um, I'll swap the filter on the AC1 at half two. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry—talked over the end there. At half two, and urgent?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, at half two. I'll swap it then; it's urgent, not one to slide.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Got it, Saz. AC1 filter, at half two, urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And that's separate from my line 3 screw filter, which is already done. Similar wording, different bit of kit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last one from me: I'll run a function test on the Fire Alarm Panel this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Top priority please, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. I'll take the Fire Alarm Panel function test as top priority this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: For the record, that's Sarah Okafor on the Fire Alarm Panel, this afternoon, top priority. Same person we've called Saz on the other two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, still only one of me, unfortunately. That's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Clear enough. Two filter jobs mentioned, but only the AC1 one is still open.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Correct. Line 3 screw done yesterday, and the palletiser belt isn't in today's work either.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And my relief valve comment was only an observation. Forklift Fleet inspection is already signed off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quick check before we go. Jamie, permit to work and isolation for the guard switch on two by the end of the week. Matters, but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort that. End of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, grease and check the bearings on the main conveyor this morning, and Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on the 3rd, whenever you get a chance that day.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, agreed to both. I've got the visit instead of Marcus Hale.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And mine: seals on the PRV on the boiler after lunch, normal priority; AC1 filter at half two, urgent; Fire Alarm Panel function test this afternoon, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's clear. Nothing from the finished or blocked bits has sneaked into that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. That's us.
